name: docs-site
$comment: The public docs site (ADR 0083): MkDocs + Material reading docs/ in place. `build` is the gate: a strict MkDocs build (every warning, including a dead link or anchor, fails) and then check_site.py over the built HTML. Both run through `uv run --locked --only-group docs`, which installs the `docs` uv group into .venv on first use (it is not a default group, so the release build never has it).

options.command: uv run --locked --only-group docs python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider {projectRoot}/tests

metadata.description: Unit tests of the include list, the link rewriting and the output link check, and MkDocs builds of a tiny tree (a dead link, a dead heading link and a stale include line each fail the build) and of the real docs/.

commands: uv run --locked --only-group docs python -m mkdocs build --strict -f {projectRoot}/mkdocs.yml

metadata.description: Builds the public docs site from docs/ into tools/docs-site/build/site (ignored) and fails on any dead internal link. The Storybook is added beside it by .github/workflows/pages.yml.
